answers.core: It has to be a core enhancement.
answers.workaround: It can not be worked around with a script and would require the engine to background the tasks (which they already are back grounded), but visually push them to the background. It can be worked around by opening a second instance of the Godot IDE as noted by @reduz but that is not a good solution for my portable laptop which only has 4GB of RAM and a super slow hard drive (swap is painful even on Linux), but would be perfectly acceptable for my Gaming Laptop and Desktop.

title: Add ability to export projects in the background
